scope: Cooperative cancellation of PDF fast-path eight-bit RGB conversion

verified: Gray, RGB and CMYK conversion of 6147 pixels each matches the original whole-buffer conversion byte-for-byte.
Every observed cancellation checkpoint refuses without a partial buffer.
Real PDF/AI RAM, swap and Metal frame qualification continues to pass.
limitations: Encoded filter decoding, component unpacking, transfer functions and other rendering phases remain incompletely interruptible.
